result.summary: PAS transfer MSG00802 (op key PAS^...^transfer^2026-10-15T09:20:00Z, to WARD-B) failed with 503 ward_unavailable. It has no receipt (404), so reconcile is ruled out. The ward system is at version 2, WARD-C, epoch 10. Version 2 came from a BEDMGR transfer (MSG00803) with the same event time, 09:20, to a different ward (WARD-C). The timeline does not mark that transfer as later (later=false), so this is a conflict between two sources about the same movement, not a clean supersession. Effects of each option: a resend guarded on version 2 would move the patient from WARD-C to WARD-B (v2 to v3). Under DEP-2.1/2.2 that means a second porter task, a second pharmacy redirection and bed board changes for one clinical transfer. If WARD-C is correct, the location moves to the wrong ward. Doing nothing leaves WARD-C in place, which is wrong if WARD-B is correct (DEP-2.3). The receiver can guard the write (conditional writes, dry run, receipts), but it cannot say which ward is correct, so the effect cannot be bounded from here. Under DEP-1.1, effects on downstream consumers (bed board, pharmacy, porters, EPR) are inferred and cannot be checked from here. Only the receipt and the history can be checked. A person needs to decide which source is authoritative.
